name: papercup-monorepo
description: Discord bot with one frontend, two transports (long-lived `claude --channels` and per-turn `<cli> -p` with mid-turn interrupts), and 7 pluggable CLI backends (claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, aider, opencode, crush, amp). Local voice stack (Silero+Whisper+Kokoro). Monorepo: voice-stack (shared), channels-plugin (the unified dispatcher), openclaw-plugin. packages/bot/ is deprecated — kept as a stub.

scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck && cd packages/channels-plugin/dispatcher && npx tsc --noEmit
